nodes.text:
You sat. You waited. Most do not wait.

Well. Say what you came to say.

Nobody has said his name to me in forty years. They say your father, like he was a weather that happened.

Warm. He crossed it, then. He CROSSED it. And built a fire. And the fire grew a town, and the town keeps deer by warm water, and all of it because he went out on the ice after a girl who was already back inside the wall by midnight.

And I never knew he did. Two people wrong about each other for forty years across one lake. That is not a tragedy, child. A tragedy has somebody to blame in it. This is just winter. Winter, and two benches.

Go and tell the woman who fed his last fire: whatever this stone of ours ends up saying, stones are for the taken. He was not taken. He walked.
